'''The White Crescent''' is an inn in the city of [[Tear]] run by [[Cavan Lopar]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, White Crescent, The}} [[Mat]] and [[Thom]] stayed there whilst searching for [[Elayne]], [[Nynaeve]], [[Egwene]], and their pursuer, the [[Darkfriend]] [[Comar]].{{ref/book|3|49}}
